title: Aqua Heart Drops — Silver
desc: Open C-arc in white metal — round brilliants along the outer edge, upright baguettes along the inner wall — with a pale blue heart-cut stone hanging point-down from the bottom tip.

title: Baguette Halo Drops
desc: A circle of channel-set baguettes above a round white pearl drop.

title: Bold Dome Huggies
desc: Solid mid-weight yellow gold huggie hoop, plain polished, hinged snap closure.

title: Lilac Papillon Ring
desc: One solid four-wing butterfly in warm yellow gold, its wings filled edge to edge with dense micro-pavé of pale violet-lilac stones inside crisp gold bezels, a plain gold body bar between them. It sits over an openwork gold frame whose larger butterfly outline is traced in tiny round clear stones. Slim plain gold shank.

title: Petite Bow Studs
desc: Small bow of stone-set gold ribbon — two loops and a centre knot.

title: Petite Square Huggies
desc: Squared-off yellow gold huggie — four straight sides with softly rounded corners.

title: Prism Cluster Studs — Silver
desc: Curved cluster stud in white metal: purple princess, pink baguette, yellow emerald-cut at the centre, purple princess, pink baguette — with six tiny round white pearls tucked in the gaps.

title: Quatrefoil Éclat Studs
desc: Four-lobed quatrefoil clover, each lobe filled edge to edge with micro-pavé clear stones in yellow gold.

title: Rivière Huggies — Silver
desc: Eternity huggie in white metal: round brilliants shared-prong set edge to edge the whole way round, no metal showing between neighbours.

title: Torsade Huggies
desc: Small yellow gold huggie with a twisted-rope surface running the whole hoop.

title: Verdant Cushion Studs
desc: Green cushion-cut centre stone ringed by a halo of round clear stones, yellow gold.
